Waveform presets in `waveforms.js` are from `dungeonlab-open/dglab-kit`,
commit `3e7ed447e387c2fa52f2c27353c27ff295b0bdeb`, `src/waveform/coyote.ts`.
BUBBLE, RHYTHM and CLIMB raw frames were extracted without modification.
Upstream license: GNU GPL v3, reproduced in `LICENSE.dglab-kit`.

Protocol references (not runtime dependencies):
- https://github.com/dungeonlab-open/dglab-kit/tree/3e7ed447e387c2fa52f2c27353c27ff295b0bdeb
- https://github.com/dungeonlab-open/dglab-websocket-server/tree/bf6fdd1625d8a76eafc97c38c660c6a3fd71c1d1
